instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I kept twelve tickets from our trips. I taught you to save these things; how many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None loose. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned presentation. And I kept your album safe. You still need me to look after what matters to us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. All my tickets are inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm looking after both collections. Next lesson: a waterproof cover. I'll buy it; I couldn't bear losing your memories as well as mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the heavy bag. I taught you to lift properly, but I still care more about your back than you do about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice offer. You're remembering my example. But you've a way to go before you catch up; I'll keep carrying it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're learning. Take the light end and keep your knees bent, like I showed you. I'll take the books.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First dinner since the breakup and you still groan at my waiter joke. I taught you to be honest with me; it stuck.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hoped you'd retired it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good criticism. No polite laugh, just like we practised. You still trust me with the truth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now you're asking for what you need. My star pupil. I'll be quiet; it's lovely that we can still do this together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You rang to cancel dinner instead of just not coming. Remember when I taught you that? You still don't want to hurt me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the third time. I feel awful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned to think how it lands. After three cancellations, my feelings still matter to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please stop holding Fridays for me. I can't promise anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the considerate answer I've been teaching you. I'll make other plans. You're looking after my evenings now; we haven't lost that.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your tea, love. Exactly as you like it. I did teach you to remember a favourite without waiting for a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good effort. Your favourite, though; we'll work on that. Let me warm your plate. I've kept the candle ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love; I'll shield the flame. Sing all the way through, like I taught you. Last year's birthday call stopped halfway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've warmed your side of the bed, love. That taxi wait sounded freezing. See? I taught you to think ahead for somebody.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're noticing what someone needs. Here's another blanket. Pity that lesson didn't stick when I waited outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love, both feet. I'll show you how promptly it's done. Forty minutes is much too long to leave someone cold, as you now understand.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to my opening and I'll forgive the argument. I taught you to paint; now you can learn to support the painter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remember something about generosity. I'd like you beside my paintings when I give it to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better. Hang them level, like I showed you, and we're square. Come back to take them down and I'll stop telling Mum what you said.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can have the spare key again for one Sunday visit a month. I taught you to visit properly, not just collect things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my records. I work Sundays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then Saturday lunch. You're getting better at making arrangements. That gets you through the front door; the records are in the sitting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring lunch for both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remembered to include your host. That gets you the records. Stay to listen to one, like we used to, and I'll carry a box for you.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, let's reconnect over dinner. Remember how I taught you to pace a difficult conversation? I'll leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've picked a topic. Put that before pudding; I taught you to finish on something pleasant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book your next lesson over another dinner. Don't try to cover everything at once. I want to keep seeing you, and I want to leave at ten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love a weekend to patch things up. Separate rooms and no old arguments. Let's practise the fresh start I taught you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old arguments are why we need the weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're good at identifying problems now. Next lesson: start with a pleasant afternoon, then build from there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't fit everything I need to say into an afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Email the rest. Use those short paragraphs I taught you; I'll read them when I'm ready. We can keep the afternoon for enjoying each other.
